messages:
Ravi M.: quick sync notes — customers keep asking for clear residency guarantees and a predictable burst model. want to align on launch rubric today.
Clara (PM): +1. proposing 3 launch lanes: Residency-Guaranteed, Residency-Preferred, and Best-Effort. map customers to lanes in sales playbook.
Ben Eng: technical callouts: Residency-Guaranteed requires model weight residency OR signed fallback policy. replication costs could be material.
Ana S.: from legal: if we promise Residency-Guaranteed we need audit logs + dataflow diagrams + contract addendum. timeline ~6-8 weeks extra.
Sales Ops: top asks: per-tenant route override, dedicated burst pool, and explicit fallthrough semantics during DR. mark overrides and burst as high revenue drivers.
Ravi M.: proposed minimal rollout gates per lane:
- Residency-Guaranteed: KMS, audit logs, model-locality proof, SLA 99.9% region-local success
- Residency-Preferred: control-plane policy + documented fallback with customer opt-in, SLA 99.5%
- Best-Effort: doc only, no SLA
OpsBot: note: automated canary job scheduled 2025-09-10 02:00 UTC (dry-run).
Ben Eng: runtime approach: implement policy DSL in control plane first. enforcement staged: host-level shims -> dedicated runtime -> private package. allows customers to author policies early.
Clara (PM): good. need acceptance criteria for canary: failure delta <1.5%, latency p95 <= baseline *1.25, and no auth regressions.
Ana S.: legal checklist action: I will produce contract language templates for Residency-Guaranteed and Residency-Preferred by next Tue.
Sales Ops: Console UI for per-tenant overrides is a must-have for Q4. will provide mocks this week.
Ravi M.: action items:
- Ben: cost estimate for weight replication (due Fri)
- Clara: map top 15 customers to lanes and draft messaging (due Wed)
- Ana: legal templates (due Tue)
- Sales Ops: Console mocks for overrides (due Thu)
Ben Eng: thinking about cache strategy: local KV TTL + async warm-up for replicas to reduce cold-start impact on burst pools. will prototype.
Clara (PM): we'll keep rollout conservative. publish rubric and gating checklist after next sync. thanks all.
